Maybe it would be easier for review purposes to not move the functions around and change the code in the same patch.

We could just put the
```
namespace configuration {
...
}
```

around where the function was originally defined (around line 22).
we'll have different behavior here now, right?  I think we loaded configurations each time on an update (which I agree, seems wasteful).
Yes. That was my reason for this particular change.
Adding more namespaces doesn't seem helpful here.  There's not a good sense for what this namespace is for, and it only contains 3 method definitions;  Should we just keep these free methods?
It was in the past, but when I introduced the namespace, it was planed as an intermediate step all along. I broke it up now to not confuse it with the class.
This really should've been vector and unordered_set... oh well.
Easy request. Did as you wished

Tested this change on my board, looks good to me.

The configuration is only loaded once, at the start, there are no redundant loads after that.

```
Jul 01 09:06:04 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 systemd[1]: Starting Entity Manager...
Jul 01 09:06:04 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 systemd[1]: Started Entity Manager.
Jul 01 09:06:08 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 entity-manager[2809]: Finished loading json configuration in 3862ms
```

The inventory is added as expected
```
Jul 01 09:06:13 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 entity-manager[2809]: Inventory Added: Supermicro PWS 920P SQ 0
Jul 01 09:06:13 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 entity-manager[2809]: Inventory Added: Supermicro PWS 920P SQ 1
Jul 01 09:06:13 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 entity-manager[2809]: Inventory Added: chassis
Jul 01 09:06:13 s8030-bmc-30303035c0c1 entity-manager[2809]: Inventory Added: MBX 1.57 Chassis
```

busctl output also looks fine.

Just an idea, 

we can mention this in the commit message, that the redundant calls to ```loadConfigurations``` have been removed.

It may be obvious to you but others might wonder why these calls have been removed.

The debug log level is great for tracking this. Should be no need to test again since the inventory in the logs already shows the configurations must have been loaded.
